items.title: 2nd Marine Division, France’s 6th Light Armoured Brigade Strengthen Alliance Through Historic Training
items.description: MARINE CORPS AIR GROUND COMBAT CENTER, Calif. — U.S. Marines with 2nd Battalion, 2nd Marine Regiment, 2nd Marine Division (2nd MARDIV) and French marines with the 21st Marine Infantry Regiment (21st RIMa), 6th Light Armoured Brigade (6th LAB) conducted the first ever live-fire bilateral training together during the Integrated Training Exercise (ITX) as part of Service Level Training Exercise 4-26 (SLTE 4-26).
